runs.question: Which four functions make up the NIST AI RMF Core, and which one is described as cross-cutting?

answer.text:
The AI RMF Core is made up of four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE (NIST AI 100-1 AI RMF 1.0 Part 2: Core and Profiles).

GOVERN is the function described as cross-cutting. It is meant to span the other three and shape them throughout (Governance is designed to be a cross-cutting function to inform and be infused throughout the other three functions.). The framework also notes that GOVERN applies to all stages of organizations' AI risk management processes and procedures, while the MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE functions can be applied in AI system-specific contexts and at specific stages of the AI lifecycle.
